text: Through a detailed review of the Bike Share Toronto revenue collection procedures, Toronto Parking Authority has worked with its third-party partners to agree on the reconciliation of under reported receivables. The purpose of this report is to provide an update on a proposed settlement with Toronto Parking Authority's contractors involved in the Bike Share Toronto program. Confidential Attachment 1 contains information pertaining to potential litigation and contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Deferred consideration of the item to a special meeting to be called by the Chair.
